tagline: Transforming mobility with safer, greener and more connected solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross margin is the key KPI as it reflects operational performance amid inflationary pressures and restructuring, showing structural improvement despite rising costs.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue that remains after deducting production costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin increases from 18.8% in 2024 to 19.1% in 2025, driven by improved operational performance despite higher variable costs.
kpis.signal: Improvement despite inflation and rising volumes.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from the company's core business activities.
kpis.description: Net sales reach $20,398 million in 2025, up 3% versus 2024, supported by volume growth (+3%) and favorable foreign exchange effects.
kpis.signal: Growth driven by North America and Asia-Pacific.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin declines to 5.8% in 2025 (vs 9.3% in 2024) due to a $648M impairment charge on Wind River and $178M in separation-related costs.
kpis.signal: Decline due to Wind River impairment charges and separation costs.

kpis.name: Research and Development Investment
kpis.explanation: Innovation spending as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Engineering and development costs are included in cost of sales (approximately 50% of total cost), with the source not providing an explicit R&D/revenue ratio.
kpis.signal: Stable investment integrated into production costs.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on new equipment or facilities.
kpis.description: The exact capex amount is not provided in the 2025 10-K. The company mentions investments in advanced technologies and industrial footprint rotation.
kpis.signal: Capex to support innovation and technological transition.

kpis.name: Restructuring Costs
kpis.explanation: Expenses related to workforce reductions or plant closures.
kpis.description: $185 million in restructuring charges in 2025, compared to $193 million in 2024, related to site closures in Europe and workforce optimization.

kpis.name: Separation Costs
kpis.explanation: Expenses related to the spin-off of the Electrical Distribution Systems business.
kpis.description: $178 million in costs related to the separation of the Electrical Distribution Systems segment announced in January 2025, included in SG&A.
kpis.signal: Major one-time charge impacting operating profitability.

kpis.name: Goodwill Impairment
kpis.explanation: Non-cash loss on the value of a subsidiary recorded on the balance sheet.
kpis.description: $648 million impairment on the Wind River unit in 2025, due to a reassessment of its future performance and commercial outlook.
kpis.signal: Large non-cash charge affecting operating income.

kpis.name: Volume Growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in sales volume, excluding price and currency effects.
kpis.description: Volumes increase by 3% in 2025, driven by North America and Asia-Pacific, despite a decline in Europe (global automotive production growth of 4%).
kpis.signal: Growth in line with global automotive production.

kpis.name: Foreign Exchange Impact
kpis.explanation: Effect of currency exchange rate fluctuations on sales.
kpis.description: Favorable impact of $129 million on sales in 2025 due to currency movements, primarily the euro's appreciation.
kpis.signal: Favorable impact mainly linked to the euro.

risks.title: Economic volatility and impact on automotive sales
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned first in risk factors, the language is strong (adverse effect, significant reduction). Impact on automotive sales and production is a key factor for APTV. Economic volatility is a recurring macroeconomic risk.

risks.title: Global supply chain disruptions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed and mentioned multiple times, highlighting potential production interruptions. Events are outside our control and have impacted inventory levels.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks and trade barriers
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical conflicts, sanctions, and trade restrictions (USMCA, tariffs) are detailed in risk factors, with potential impact on regional production and costs.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence was found in the provided text.
